name: Knock Out (Combat)
body:
The weak fall from the fury of your fists.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack

Benefit: When making a successful unarmed Power Attack against an enemy that is 4 levels lower than you, they must make a Fortitude saving throw DC 10 + 1/2 hit dice + Strength modifier. On a failed saving throw, the enemy is stunned for 1d4 rounds. On a successful saving throw, the enemy is staggered for 1d4 rounds.
